organization.name: Blockchain Club LAUTECH
organization.tagline: Building the Future, One Block at a Time.
organization.vision: To create a LAUTECH where every student is equipped with blockchain knowledge and contributes to Nigeria's leadership in Web3 innovation.
organization.mission: To empower LAUTECH students with blockchain expertise, drive innovation, and build a vibrant ecosystem for future blockchain leaders through workshops, hackathons, and collaborative projects.
organization.description: Connecting curious minds to blockchain education, hands-on experience, and a community of future tech leaders.

history.p1: Blockchain club lautech, founded 2020 by a group of innovatives driven by the mission to teach beyond technical knowledge, to demystify the blockchain and make it accessible to beginners while also providing advanced learning opportunities for more experienced members.
history.p2: The club was established as a collaborative learning community where members could explore the fundamentals of blockchain technology, understand how cryptocurrencies function, and examine real world applications across every sector.
history.p3: Through structured activities including workshops, seminars, hackathons and collaborative projects, blockchain club lautech fosters an environment that encourages innovation, critical thinking, and skill development.

team.quote: Our team is made up of passionate builders, innovators, and problem-solvers dedicated to exploring the endless various possibilities of blockchain technology.They are committed to fostering innovation, collaboration, and education within the ecosystem.

cohorts.header: Level up your Web3 Skills with a Cohorts
cohorts.subHeader: Our Cohort Programs are structured learning tracks designed to help students gain real-world blockchain skills in focused areas.

tracks.title: Web & Blockchain Dev Cohort
tracks.description: Build modern web apps and decentralized applications from scratch, frontend to smart contracts.
tracks.targetAudience: Aspiring developers who want to build real blockchain-based products from day one.

phase1.title: Web2 Track (Foundation)
phase1.subtitle: Core technologies for building modern web applications...
phase1.outcome: Build and deploy functional web applications and understand modern development workflows.

phase2.title: Web3 Track (Blockchain)
phase2.subtitle: Transition into decentralized development...
phase2.outcome: Build basic dApps and understand how blockchain integrates with web applications end-to-end.

timeline.title: Web Fundamentals
timeline.detail: HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics & version control

timeline.title: Build & Ship
timeline.detail: Smart contracts, dApp dev & final project demo

tracks.title: Design & Product Cohort
tracks.description: Design user-friendly and visually compelling Web3 products that people actually want to use.
tracks.targetAudience: Creative students into design, branding, and user experience within the Web3 space.
